risk_note: RV2 commission (BR-CALC-12 / 13 snapshot side; decision D10-118). Adds createSnapshotBeneficiaryResolver in apps/api/src/modules/commission/infra/beneficiary-resolver.ts: self, direct and indirect beneficiaries and their levels as of paidAt, read only through the growth GrowthHistory port (levelAt / parentAt, replaying the relation log by at, which B1-11t #1116 now writes equal to created_at) and the identity UserDeletionStatusReader port inside the caller's transaction; a missing level log falls back to L1 with a warning; deleting / deleted / missing users are forfeited with reason deleted. No money arithmetic, no schema change; commission index exports the factory and the in-memory resolver keeps its shape.
